meta_description: Pure Decorating is a Bristol-based painter and decorator offering interior and exterior work. Free quotes, fully insured. Call 07956 759927.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert decoration work. Free quotes, honest pricing, and a finish that lasts.
services_subhead: From interior refreshes to full external repaints, we handle domestic and commercial projects with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Transform living spaces with quality paint finishes, feature walls, and colour consultation. We protect your furniture and leave no mess behind.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior repaints for houses and buildings. We prepare surfaces thoroughly to ensure long-lasting protection against Bristol's elements.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging
services.desc: Expert wallpaper installation on any room or commercial space. We handle pattern matching and create a seamless, professional finish.

services.title: Surface Preparation
services.desc: Proper prep work is the foundation of every job. We sand, fill, and prime surfaces to guarantee a flawless paint finish.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Offices, shops, and rental properties painted to specification. We work around your schedule and minimise disruption to your business.

services.title: Specialty Finishes
services.desc: Textured coatings, faux effects, and bespoke colour work. We bring character and personality to your interiors and exteriors.

about_pullquote: Good decoration should speak for itself. No shortcuts, no compromise.
about_para_1: Pure Decorating was founded on a simple principle: do the job properly or don't do it at all. Over 12 years, we've built a reputation across Bristol for meticulous surface preparation, colour expertise, and finishes that stand the test of time. Every project—whether a single bedroom or a multi-storey commercial building—receives the same level of care and attention.
about_para_2: We're fully insured, punctual, and we treat your home with the respect it deserves. Customers return to us because we listen, we deliver on time, and we leave sites clean. That's not fancy—it's how decorating should work.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Pure Decorating

reviews.text: Needed my hallway and stairs done urgently before Christmas. Mark turned up when he said he would, worked efficiently, and the finish is brilliant. Tidy worker, fair price. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Got a free quote, no pressure to book. Mark was honest about what the job needed and the timescale. Work was done to a high standard, walls are perfectly smooth. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jennifer M.

reviews.text: Had our whole exterior repainted. Weather's been brutal but the paint is holding up perfectly. Mark's attention to prep work really showed. Professional, reliable, and reasonably priced.
reviews.author: Robert S.

address_sub: Serving Bristol and surrounding areas including Southville, Bedminster, Totterdown, and beyond
